xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. Nuvama Wealth Management Limited (the 'Company') has prepared consolidated financial results (the 'Statement') for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 in accordance with Regulation 33 and 52 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 as amended (the 'Listing Regulations, 2015') and the Accounting Standards specified under section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the Companies ('Indian Accounting Standards') Rules, 2015 as amended and the relevant provision of the Companies Act, 2013, as applicable.

2. The consolidated financial results of the Company and its subsidiaries (together referred to as 'Group'), its associate and joint venture for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 have been reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their meetings held on November 06, 2026. Refer Annexure 1 for list of subsidiaries, associate and joint venture forming part of consolidated financial results.

3. The above consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 have been subjected to limited review by the Statutory Auditors of the Company and the auditors have issued an unmodified review report.

4. Earnings per share for the quarter and half year ended are not annualised.

5. On September 02, 2026, the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India allowed Nuvama Clearing Services Limited’s ('NCSL'), Subsidiary of the Company, appeal in the matters relating to Anugrah Stock & Broking Private Limited and V-Rise Securities Private Limited (collectively referred to as 'Trading Members') thereby setting aside the impugned orders of the Securities Appellate Tribunal and the Membership and Core Settlement Guarantee Fund Committee which had directed reinstatement of securities (alleged to be wrongly liquidated) to the end clients of the Trading Members. Accordingly, the matters stand concluded in favour of NCSL.

6. "The Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on November 04, 2025, approved the sub-division of each equity share having a face value of Rs.10/- (Rupees Ten only), fully paid-up, into 5 (five) equity shares having a face value of Rs. 2/- (Rupees Two only), fully paid-up. Subsequently, the approval of the shareholders was obtained through a postal ballot on December 07, 2025.

Consequently, with effect from the Record Date of December 26, 2025, the authorised share capital and paid-up share capital of the Company have been sub-divided into equity shares of face value Rs. 2/- each. Accordingly, the Earnings Per Share (EPS) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2025 has been adjusted/restated appropriately."

7. On August 7, 2026, the Company acquired the remaining 26% equity stake in Pickright Technologies Private Limited from the non-controlling shareholders. Consequently, Pickright Technologies Private Limited became a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company with effect from August 7, 2026.

8. Previous periods/ year figures have been regrouped/ re-classified wherever necessary in line with the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The impact, if any, are not material to the financial results.

9. These consolidated financial results are available on the website of BSE Limited ('BSE') (www.bseindia.com), National Stock Exchange of India Limited ('NSE') (www.nseindia.com) and Company's website (www.nuvama.com).
